item.title: Lupin Announces U.S. FDA Approval and Launch of Sitagliptin Tablets, USP in the United States - Lupin | Press Release
item.description: 2026-11-27 | UNSEEN_IN_DATE_WINDOW_TIME_UNCERTAIN | Mumbai, India, Naples, Fla, November 27, 2026: Global pharma major Lupin Limited (Lupin) today announced that following the approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA), the company launched Sitagliptin Tablets USP
